title: The Gone Guitar
scene: At 4:45 PM, the shop vintage guitar disappeared. The alarm test locked the display room from 4:30 to 5:00.

suspects.name: Elena Cruz
suspects.testimony: I was at the register at 4:45, talking to a customer.
suspects.alibiProof: The register camera shows Elena with a customer at 4:44.

suspects.name: Finn Ash
suspects.testimony: I was restringing a lute in the workshop at 4:45.
suspects.alibiProof: The bench camera shows Finn's hands at 4:43 and 4:47.

suspects.name: Gina Voss
suspects.testimony: I was in the display room at 4:45, dusting the stands.
suspects.contradiction: The display room was sealed by the alarm test, and guitar polish was on Gina's sleeves.

suspects.name: Hugo Lund
suspects.testimony: I was carrying boxes to the stockroom at 4:45.
suspects.alibiProof: The stockroom dolly log shows Hugo's scan at 4:42 and 4:49.
